result.question: What did Jehoiada give commanders?

readings.answer: the spears and shields of King David from the house of the LORD
readings.support: the spears and shields of King David from the house of the LORD

assessments.reason: Verse 11:10 explicitly says the priest gave the commanders “the spears and shields of King David,” matching the key exactly.

result.reason: 11:10 explicitly states Jehoiada gave the commanders the spears and shields of King David.
